issues.description: In the template, the fields `lectureName` and `numberOfInscribedStudents` are declared as `public`, but the problem statement UML specifies all Lecture attributes as private ("-") and the reference solution declares these fields `private`. This conflicts with the intended encapsulation/getter-setter design and can mislead students into using direct field access instead of implementing accessors.
issues.suggestedFix: In `template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java`, change `public String lectureName;` and `public int numberOfInscribedStudents;` to `private` (or remove these premature declarations entirely and have students add all attributes per UML). This aligns the template with the UML and the solution and reinforces using getters/setters.
